page.text:
The Axiom of Extensionality articulates the fundamental identity
criterion of set theory: a set is completely and exhaustively determined
by its members. Extensionality contrasts sharply with *intensional*
descriptions: two descriptions that appear entirely distinct (such as
'the set of even prime numbers' and 'the positive square root of $4$ in
singleton form') represent the identical set $\{2\}$. Sets possess no
internal ordering, no spatial arrangement, and no multiplicity of
membership.
